player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''COTEB''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.

starting.card: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed

description: Went 5-1 in Montreal (Warm up + DPC) lost to Chris Terwilliger
cards: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (frozen there per the Objective), Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace and Anakin's Podracer; these count toward the 60. Han is also posted under Characters, so the deck plays two.
Posted 'Tatooine JP' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (the plain page is Dark); 'Tatooine AC' dested Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, the site Profit starts.
Posted 'Lando w/Blaster' dested the character Lando With Blaster Pistol (the strategy's 'Lando with Gun'), not Lando's Blaster Rifle.

Posted 'Battle Plan/DTF combo' dested Battle Plan & Draw Their Fire; 'Shocking/Grimtash' Shocking Information & Grimtaash; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Bith Shuffle/Desperate' The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach; 'Sense/Recoil in Fear' Sense & Recoil In Fear; Weapon Levitation dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.

Posted 'Qui Gon's Stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, after this post); 'Master Qui Gon' Master Qui-Gon; 'Naked Threepio' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'R2 in Red 5' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Luke w/ Saber' / 'Obi w/ Saber' Luke With Lightsaber / Obi-Wan With Lightsaber.

Posted 'Hoth War Room' dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Home 1 War Room' Home One: War Room; 'Rendevous Point' Rendezvous Point; 'Honour of the jedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'A Jedi's Resiliance' A Jedi's Resilience; 'A Step Backwards' A Step Backward.
The 'Epic Events' section header was mis-parsed by the machine draft as a card and is dropped; I Did It! is the one card under it.

The description says the deck went 5-1 across the Montreal warm-up tournament and the DPC, losing to Chris Terwilliger; the post does not split the record between the two events. The deck is based on Martin Akesson's pre-Coruscant Podprofit (DeckTech deck 18079), with about nine card changes.
